steps.en: Star or watch the repo to be notified of each new Claude Code version
steps.zh: 给仓库点星或 watch，每出一个 Claude Code 新版就收到通知

steps.en: After a Claude Code release, pulls the prompt strings out of the compiled package
steps.zh: Claude Code 发版后，从编译包里抽出提示词字符串

steps.en: Writes one Markdown file per prompt with version, variables and token count
steps.zh: 每段提示词写成一个 Markdown 文件，带版本、变量和 token 数

steps.en: Publishes a changelog entry of new, removed and reworded prompts, plus a release
steps.zh: 发布变更日志条目（新增、删除、改写）和一个 release

steps.en: Open the entry for your version, then the prompt file that explains the new behaviour
steps.zh: 打开你这个版本的条目，再点开解释新行为的那个提示词文件

value.en: You see exactly which built-in instruction changed, without decompiling Claude Code yourself
value.zh: 不用自己反编译 Claude Code，就能看清到底是哪条内置指令变了
